```{r}
source("07_add_light_treatment.R")

data_full <- readRDS('data_full.rds')

data_env <- data_env %>%
  left_join(
    lighting %>%
      select(date, color, intensity, block),
    by = "date"
  )

data_env <- data_env %>%
  mutate(
    color = factor(color),
    site = factor(site),
    #intensity = factor(intensity),
    block = factor(block)
  )

data_env <- data_env %>%
  filter(
      !is.na(intensity),
      !is.na(color)
    ) 

#data_env <- data_env %>%
  #mutate(intensity_bin = case_when(

    #intensity > 70 & intensity <= 85 ~ 'high',
    #intensity > 85 ~ 'very high'
  #))
```

```{r}
sky_brightness <- read.csv(
  "sky_brightness_measurements.csv"
)


sky_brightness <- sky_brightness %>%
  mutate(
     file_name_clean = 
        tools::file_path_sans_ext(filename),
     site = 
        stringr::word(file_name_clean, 2, sep = "_"),
  )

sky_brightness <- sky_brightness %>%
  mutate(site = toupper(site))

sky_brightness <- sky_brightness %>%
  group_by(site) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_brightness_site = mean(mean_brightness, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

data_env <- data_env %>%
  left_join(
    sky_brightness,
    by = "site"
  )
data_env <- data_env %>%
  filter(
      !is.na(mean_brightness_site)
    ) 
data_env <- data_env %>%
  filter(species != "HiF")

```

```{r}
source("06_run_models.R")
models <- run_models(data_env)

AIC(m0,m1,m2)

anova(m0,m1)
anova(m1,m2)

sim <- simulateResiduals(m2)

plot(sim)

testDispersion(sim)

testZeroInflation(sim)

summary(models$m2)
```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(ggeffects)


ggplot(data_env,
       aes(intensity, detections,
           color = color)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.3) +
  geom_smooth(method = "loess") +
  facet_wrap(~ year) +
  theme_classic()


pred <- ggpredict(
  models$m2,
  terms = c("intensity [all]", "color"),
  bias_correction = TRUE
)

plot(pred)

ggplot(data_env,
       aes(intensity,
           detections,
           color = color)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.1) +
  geom_smooth(method = "loess") +
  theme_classic()

plot_data <- data_env %>%
  group_by(color, intensity) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_det = mean(detections),
    se = sd(detections)/sqrt(n()),
    .groups = 'drop'
  )

ggplot(plot_data,
       aes(intensity, mean_det, color = color)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_line() +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean_det - se,
                    ymax = mean_det + se),
                width = 2) +
  theme_classic()

ggplot(data_env,
       aes(factor(intensity),
           detections,
           fill = color)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.alpha = 0.1) +
  theme_classic()

ggplot(data_env,
       aes(intensity,
           detections)) +
  geom_hex() +
  facet_wrap(~ color) +
  theme_classic()
```

```{r}
source("04_Occurrence_Thresholds.R")

occurrences <- run_thresholds(data_env, thresholds = c(30, 60, 120, 300))

glimpse(occurrences)

occurrences %>%
  ggplot(aes(threshold_sec, occurrences, group = site, color = site)) + 
  geom_line(alpha = 0.3)

occurrences %>%
  group_by(threshold_sec) %>%
  summarise(total_occurrences = sum(occurrences))

data_30 <- occurrences %>%
  filter(threshold_sec == 30)

data_60 <- occurrences %>%
  filter(threshold_sec == 60)

data_120 <- occurrences %>%
  filter(threshold_sec == 120)

data_300 <- occurrences %>%
  filter(threshold_sec == 300)

site_env <- data_env %>%
  distinct(site, pct_forest)

occurrences <- occurrences %>%
  left_join(site_env, by = "site")
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)

effort <- data_env %>%
  group_by(site, year, color, intensity) %>%
  summarise(
    nights = n_distinct(date),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

comm_dat <- data_env %>%
  group_by(site,
           year,
           color,
           intensity,
           species) %>%
  summarise(
    detections = sum(detections),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

comm_dat <- comm_dat %>%
  left_join(
    effort,
    by = c("site", 'year', 'color', 'intensity')
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    det_per_night = detections/nights
  )

```

```{r}
community_matrix <- comm_dat %>%
  select(site,
         year,
         color,
         intensity,
         species,
         det_per_night) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = species,
    values_from = det_per_night,
    values_fill = 0
  )

env <- data_env %>%
  group_by(site,
           year,
           color,
           intensity) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_phase = first(mean_phase),
    pct_nonforest = first(pct_nonforest),
    mean_brightness_site = first(mean_brightness_site),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

community_matrix <- community_matrix %>%
  left_join(
    env,
    by = c('site',
           'year',
           'color',
           'intensity')
  )

species_cols <- setdiff(
  names(community_matrix),
  c('site',
    'year',
    'color',
    'intensity',
    'mean_phase',
    'pct_nonforest',
    'mean_brightness_site')
)

comm <- community_matrix %>%
  select(all_of(species_cols))

env <- community_matrix %>%
  select(site,
         year,
         color,
         intensity,
         mean_phase.x,
         pct_nonforest.x,
         mean_brightness_site)
```

```{r}
library(vegan)

nmds <- metaMDS(
  comm,
  distance = 'bray',
  k = 2,
  trymax = 100
)

nmds$stress
```

```{r}
scores_df <- as.data.frame(scores(nmds))

scores_df <- bind_cols(scores_df, env)

library(ggplot2)

ggplot(scores_df,
       aes(NMDS1,
           NMDS2,
           color = color)) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  theme_classic()
```

```{r}

adonis2(
  comm ~ color +
    intensity +
    mean_phase.x +
    pct_nonforest.x +
    mean_brightness_site,
  data = env,
  method = 'bray',
  permutatins = 9999
)

bc <- vegdist(comm, method = 'bray')

bd <- betadisper(bc, group = env$color)

anova(bd)
```

```{r}
db <- dbrda(
  comm ~ color +
    intensity +
    mean_phase.x +
    pct_nonforest.x +
    mean_brightness_site +
    Condition(year),
  data = env,
  distance = 'bray'
)

anova(db, permutations = 9999)

anova(db,
      by = 'margin',
      permutations = 9999)

```

```{r}
heat_dat <- comm_dat %>%
  group_by(species,
           color,
           intensity) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_det = mean(det_per_night),
    .groups = 'drop'
  )

ggplot(
  heat_dat,

      species,

) +
  geom_tile() +

```

```{r}
library(mvabund)

Y <- mvabund(comm)

fit <- manyglm(
  Y ~ color +
    intensity +
    mean_phase.x +
    pct_nonforest.x +
    mean_brightness_site +
    year,
  family = "negative.binomial",
  data = env
)

anova(
  fit,
  p.uni = "adjusted",
  nBoot = 9999
)
```
